_readme: SVG label dictionary consumed by scripts/i18n-build-svg.php.
Copy this file to labels/<lang>.json and translate ONLY the values in "translate".
Keys in "translate" are exact English text nodes from docs/*.svg — never change a key.
Never translate: class names, method names, algorithm identifiers, file paths, code snippets.
Keep numbers, arrows (→), bullets (·) and the ① ② ③ ④ markers as they are.
If a translation is much longer than the English text, the build script shrinks the font size automatically;
shorten the wording if a label ends up cramped.
Everything listed in "keep" is copied verbatim into the localised SVGs — do not edit that list.
"font_size" pins the font size of layout labels that sit in wide-open space (diagram titles, card headers),
so translations of very different lengths still look consistent. It is read from this file for every language;
a language file may override single entries. Do not add labels here unless you checked there is room for them.

translate.A friendly padlock mascot with a keyhole: A friendly padlock mascot with a keyhole smile, waving with one arm and holding a golden key in the other. It represents the pluggable cryptography library: symmetric/asymmetric ciphers, hashing, key derivation and the Chinese national algorithms.
